prompt: Which symbol makes this true? Compare: $-5 \;?\; -8$. Type $<$, $>$, or $=$.
hint: Picture both numbers on a number line. The number farther to the **right** is always the greater one, even for negatives.
explanation: On a number line, numbers get larger as you move right and smaller as you move left.
$-8$ is $8$ steps left of $0$ and $-5$ is only $5$ steps left, so $-8$ is farther left.
That puts $-5$ to the right of $-8$, which makes $-5$ the greater number.
The true statement is $-5 > -8$, so the symbol is $>$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Think about temperature
steps: $-8^\circ$F is **colder** than $-5^\circ$F — so $-5$ is the warmer (larger) number.

hints.text: Picture both numbers on a number line. The number farther to the **right** is always the greater one, even for negatives.
Starting at $0$ and going left, you reach $-5$ before you reach $-8$. Decide which of the two sits farther right.
$-5$ is to the right of $-8$, so $-5 > -8$ and the symbol is $>$.
